+	"errors"

+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
 
+const minSecretLen = 32
+
+// payload builds the MAC input from the base64url-encoded taskID/actor
+// fields (the same encoding used in the token), joined with ".". Base64url
+// output never contains "." or "|", so this encoding is unambiguous: there
+// is exactly one (taskID, actor) pair that maps to a given payload. MACing
+// over the raw, unencoded fields joined by a separator would not have this
+// property, since taskID/actor can contain the separator and allow the
+// field boundary to be shifted without changing the signed bytes.
+func payload(taskID, actor string, expires time.Time) []byte {
+	encTaskID := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(taskID))
+	encActor := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(actor))
+	return []byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s.%d", encTaskID, encActor, expires.UTC().Unix()))
+}
+
+func mac(secret, msg []byte) []byte {
+	h := hmac.New(sha256.New, secret)
+	h.Write(msg)
+	return h.Sum(nil)
+}
+
+// Sign creates a signed approval token binding taskID, actor, and the UTC
+// expiry, using HMAC-SHA256 keyed by secret.
 func Sign(secret []byte, taskID, actor string, expires time.Time) (string, error) {
-	return "", nil
+	if len(secret) < minSecretLen {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: secret must be at least 32 bytes")
+	}
+	if taskID == "" {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: taskID must not be empty")
+	}
+	if actor == "" {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: actor must not be empty")
+	}
+
+	msg := payload(taskID, actor, expires)
+	sig := mac(secret, msg)
+
+	encTaskID := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(taskID))
+	encActor := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(actor))
+	encSig := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString(sig)
+
+	token := fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s.%d.%s", encTaskID, encActor, expires.UTC().Unix(), encSig)
+	return token, nil
 }
 
+// Verify validates a signed approval token against the expected taskID and
+// the provided now time (UTC), returning the authenticated actor on success.
 func Verify(secret []byte, token, taskID string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
-	return "", nil
+	if len(secret) < minSecretLen {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: secret must be at least 32 bytes")
+	}
+	if taskID == "" {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: taskID must not be empty")
+	}
+
+	parts := strings.Split(token, ".")
+	if len(parts) != 4 {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: malformed token")
+	}
+
+	rawTaskID, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[0])
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: malformed token")
+	}
+	rawActor, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[1])
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: malformed token")
+	}
+	var expiresUnix int64
+	if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(parts[2], "%d", &expiresUnix); err != nil {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: malformed token")
+	}
+	sig, err := base64.URLEncoding.DecodeString(parts[3])
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: malformed token")
+	}
+
+	gotTaskID := string(rawTaskID)
+	gotActor := string(rawActor)
+	expires := time.Unix(expiresUnix, 0).UTC()
+
+	msg := payload(gotTaskID, gotActor, expires)
+	expectedSig := mac(secret, msg)
+	if !hmac.Equal(sig, expectedSig) {
+		return "", errors.New("approval: invalid signature")
+	}

+		return "", errors.New("approval: task ID mismatch")
+	}
+

+	}

+
+// TestApprovalRejectsFieldBoundaryForgery reproduces the "|"-ambiguity
+// forgery: a token signed for taskID="ship|prod", actor="alice" is
+// re-partitioned as taskID="ship", actor="prod|alice". Before the fix, the
+// MAC was computed over the raw concatenated string "ship|prod|alice|<exp>",
+// which is identical for both splits, so the attacker-chosen split verified
+// successfully with the original signature. After the fix, the MAC is
+// computed over the base64url-encoded fields, which differ for the two
+// splits, so the forged token must fail signature verification.
+func TestApprovalRejectsFieldBoundaryForgery(t *testing.T) {
+	secret := []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef")
+	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 15, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
+	expires := now.Add(time.Minute)
+
+	token, err := Sign(secret, "ship|prod", "alice", expires)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+
+	parts := strings.Split(token, ".")
+	if len(parts) != 4 {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected token shape: %q", token)
+	}
+	sigPart := parts[3]
+
+	// Re-encode the forged split with the same signature bytes.
+	forgedTaskID := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("ship"))
+	forgedActor := base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("prod|alice"))
+	forgedToken := fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s.%s.%s", forgedTaskID, forgedActor, parts[2], sigPart)
+
+	if _, err := Verify(secret, forgedToken, "ship", now); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("Verify() accepted a forged token with a shifted taskID/actor boundary")
+	}
+}
